chunks: And from a letter of his (peace be upon him) to Mu'awiya, at the beginning of his allegiance, al-Waqidi mentioned it in his "Kitab al-Jamal".

key_terms.الْوَقِيدِيُّ: Al-Waqidi, a prominent early Islamic historian
key_terms.كِتَابُ الْجَمَلِ: Kitab al-Jamal, a historical work by al-Waqidi detailing the Battle of the Camel
key_terms.مُعَاوِيَةَ: Mu'awiya ibn Abi Sufyan, the Umayyad caliph

ai.seo_question: Where did al-Waqidi record Imam Ali's letter to Mu'awiya?
ai.summary: This entry highlights the historical transmission of Imam Ali’s correspondence with Mu'awiya, preserved by the early historian al-Waqidi in his seminal work *Kitab al-Jamal*, which focuses on the Battle of Siffin. It underscores the scholarly tradition of documenting the political and theological discourse between the two key figures during the First Fitna, providing critical context for understanding the dynamics of early Islamic leadership.
